architecture.tokenModel: Each target owns exactly one approved 18-role vector. Generated CSS binds those roles only under exact target-theme selectors.
architecture.adapterModel: Variants retain established design roles; all ten CT accents share universal color ownership.
architecture.browserShopModel: Browser Shop adapter is generated under an exact data-global-theme-id binding. Target Browser Shop activation remains deferred to that target theme cycle; Foundation II does not add runtime binding.
architecture.rolloutModel: Generator emits tokens and only the target adapter content already authorized in the registry. PENDING targets emit nothing; partial target cycles may authorize a bounded adapter file without qualifying the whole theme.
architecture.referenceModel: Theme03 is an ordinary USER CT member; older baseline vector is retained as historical source, not a runtime exclusion.
architecture.standaloneModel: Generated aggregate is the single target-theme CSS payload. Production consumes it through _app.tsx; standalone FRONTEND/SHOP release artifacts must embed the same generated payload when a target theme is authorized. Foundation II keeps the aggregate empty, so no owner-visible runtime recolouring occurs.

adapterTemplates.law: Target adapters consume shared semantic roles and exact target selectors; no page-local decorative palette literals.

runtimeConsumers.standaloneFrontend: FRONTEND_vNNN.html release artifact; embed the exact generated aggregate only in the authorized target-theme cycle
runtimeConsumers.standaloneShop: SHOP_vNNN.html dark Global Theme surface; embed the same generated aggregate only when that target Browser Shop row is authorized

verificationBoundary.harnessStatus: HARNESS_PROBE_PASS means state/selector/computed evidence was reached; it is not final visual acceptance
verificationBoundary.theme03Smoke: Foundation II harness is qualified against locked Theme03 only as tooling evidence; Theme03 itself is not recalibrated
verificationBoundary.targetAcceptance: Each target theme requires its later bounded rendered/computed acceptance before matrix qualification

notes.theme01Recovery: Cycle0390 supersedes Cycles0387-0389 runtime projection. Theme01 returns to FRONTEND_v609 owner-good visual baseline; generator remains fail-closed until a future direct OWNER projection decision.
notes.theme01PreservationAudit: Cycle0391: 49/51 rows preserve v609 owner-good appearance; GT-SHOP-01/02 are the only confirmed foreign-chroma corrective candidates and require OWNER approval.

preserveFirstPolicy.law: Existing good rendered appearance is authority for each target theme. Shared 18-role architecture is an audit/classification tool, not permission to repaint.
preserveFirstPolicy.mutationGate: Theme-specific audit -> OWNER review -> only confirmed wrong/foreign colour correction -> OWNER-approved garbage colour-rule removal -> rendered acceptance.
preserveFirstPolicy.conditionalSlots: Unused planned polish slots must be removed/compacted rather than consumed as no-op cycles.
